instrumentIsNotSurfaceProbe: This artifact was NOT produced by scripts/surface-probe.mjs. That instrument is OPS-23's completion predicate and gates rows P-151..P-174 and P-186..P-198; G-154 is an OPS-17 row and is not gated by it (scripts/enforcement/probe-close-gate.mjs GATED_ROW is /^P-(\d+)$/). Stated so no reader mistakes this for the OPS-23 artifact. What it measures is the Development services lens' own built surface on the deployed app.

predicates.measured: tabLabelsBuilt reads exactly the shipped seven; zero matches for tab-place/place-tab. Planted eighth tab is refused: "tab strip is [Place, Pipeline, Inspections, Work orders, Code enforcement, Licenses, Plan review, Flood study]".

predicates.acceptanceItem: 2 - no named person on a published workload ranking
predicates.measured: The live surface draws NO workload ranking. Measured, not assumed: every loadstrip-head element carries hidden and display:none, and the document holds zero class="who" spans - on bastrop_tx AND on template-city. The real feed carries no load dimension, so the product hides the strip rather than drawing an empty ranking. Nothing can be named on a ranking that is not drawn. The rule itself has teeth (the check's own self-tests refuse 'R. McBain' in the load strip), and the mutation prover names this as unexercised rather than passing it silently. NOT CLAIMED AS A LIVE PROOF.

predicates.acceptanceItem: 3 - licence rows in the design's sort order
predicates.measured: 19 dated licence rows read off the live feed, in the design's own band-major order: expired (18 rows, offsets -1866..-1262), then active (5, undated), then revoked (1, -1511), then completed (26, undated). That is compareLicenseRoll's order exactly - status severity first, then offset within the band. Reversing the roll is caught: "licence rows are out of the design's order".

predicates.acceptanceItem: 4 - no resident named beside an address
predicates.measured: 200 refused-column cells read across all four header-keyed columns (Applicant, Inspector, Officer, Subject), none carrying free text. Planting a Title Case resident in the Applicant column is caught: "a refused column carries free text [Applicant=\"Dana Whitfield\"]". The only people-shaped match the shape rule found on live data was the bare situs sentinel 'TX USA' - four permits whose address is nothing but the state and country suffix, naming no person. That was an instrument false positive and is fixed; it is NOT reported as a PII leak.

It is not the OPS-23 surface-probe artifact and must not be cited as one.
It proves the Development services lens on ONE non-production deployment. It says nothing about the v1 production app, and nothing about any other lens.
